# Round64 and Round128 ("Rounding from exact parts"): the operands are
# neg, coeff, exp and sticky in declaration order; the results are the
# encoding and the Status. The input is a value in parts, so the inf, nan
# and noncanon classes do not apply; an infinite result is overflow.

# --- Round64 ---

Round64 even exact false 1 0 false -> 1 Exact
Round64 even exact false 10000000000000000 0 false -> 1.000000000000000E+16 Exact
Round64 even exact false 100 -400 false -> 1E-398 Exact
Round64 even exact false 150 -2 false -> 1.50 Exact
Round64 even exact true 5 1 false -> -5E+1 Exact
Round64 even exact false 12345678901234560 0 false -> 1.234567890123456E+16 Exact
Round64 even exact false 1000000000000000000 0 false -> 1.000000000000000E+18 Exact
Round64 even exact false 9999999999999999 0 false -> 9999999999999999 Exact
Round64 even exact false 9999999999999999 369 false -> 9.999999999999999E+384 Exact
Round64 even exact true 1234567890123456 -20 false -> -0.00001234567890123456 Exact

Round64 7 exact false 150 -2 false -> 1.50 Exact
